sentences.text: Today we will talk about traffic.
Do you drive a car?
Do you take a taxi or a bus?
Maybe you walk a lot in the city.
No matter how you travel, English is important.
Let's learn some useful words and sentences together.
Let's go.
One important traffic words.
First, let's learn some important words about traffic.
These words will help you understand signs, talk to people, and travel easily.
Traffic light.
It has three colors.
Red stop, yellow, slow down, and green go.
Car.
A vehicle that people drive.
Taxi.
A car that takes you somewhere for money.
Bus.
A big vehicle that many people use for transportation.
Train station.
A place where train stop.
Bus stop.
A place where buses stop.
Pedestrian.
A person who is walking.
Crosswalk.
White lines on the road where people can walk.
Highway.
A big road for cars and trucks.
Stop sign.
A red sign that tells drivers to stop.
Traffic jam.
Too many cars, so traffic is slow.
Great.
Now you know some important traffic words.
Let's practice using them.
Two, asking for directions.
Imagine you are in a new city.
You don't know where to go.
How can you ask for directions?
Let's learn some simple sentences.
Useful questions.
Excuse me, where is the train station?
Go straight, then turn left.
How can I go to the airport?
Take a taxi or bus number 12.
Where is the nearest bus stop?
It's on the right side near the coffee shop.
Is this the way to the shopping mall?
Yes, just keep walking straight.
Now, try to repeat after me.
These sentences are very useful when you are in a new city.
Three, talking to a taxi driver.
If you go to the airport, can you take me to this address?
Show the address on your phone.
During the ride, is this the fastest way?
Can you drive a little slower?
Can we stop at a gas station?
At the end of the ride, how much is the fare?
Here is the money.
Thank you.
Can I pay by card?
Taking a taxi is easy if you know these sentences.
Try to practice them before your next taxi ride.
Four, traffic signs and rules.
Traffic signs are important.
Let's learn some common signs and what they mean.
Red light, stop.
Green light, go.
Yellow light, slow down.
Stop sign, stop and look before you go.
Roundabout, a circular road where cars go in one direction.
No entry.
You cannot go in this direction.
Parking sign, you can park your car here.
Now, when you see these signs, you will understand them easily.
Five, emergency situations.
Sometimes there are problems in traffic.
What can you say in English?
I have a flat tire.
The tire has no air.
My car is broken.
I need help.
Call the police, please.
I need an ambulance.
There was an accident.
If you have a problem, stay calm and use these sentences.
They will help you.
Six, real life practice.
Now let's practice a short conversation.
Listen and repeat.
Person A, excuse me, where's the nearest gas station?
Person B, go straight, then turn right.
It's next to the supermarket.
Thank you very much.
You're welcome.
Great job.
Try to practice this with a friend.
That's all for today's episode.
Now you know how to speak English in traffic.
Listen again and practice with me.
If you like this podcast, don't forget to follow for more easy English lessons.
See you next time on Easy English with Emily.
Bye -bye.
